key_impacts: Shoreline and nearby city streets were flooded.
Damage occurred to shoreline homes, cottages, and public/boat docks.
Water intake pumps at a hydroelectric facility were impacted by rapid level changes.
Water level oscillations recorded: ~0.5 m in-harbor and reports up to ~2 m outside the harbor.
evidence_snippets: On April 13, 2018, meteotsunami waves struck the shores near Ludington, Michigan.
Harbor walls were overtopped; damage to shoreline homes and boat docks; water intake pumps were impacted.
Gauge recorded up to 0.5 m; NWS received reports of 2 m fluctuations outside the harbor; shoreline and city streets flooded.
missing_information: Exact counts and monetary losses not provided.
Precise spatial extent beyond the Ludington area not detailed.
